categoriesNote: matrixConstructs/emphasis are syntactic selection markers (regexes over program source), chosen to exercise the lowered_unproved and rejected rows of the LCNF coverage matrix; they are not executed-lowering measurements. The executed classification is recorded per program by run_conformance_suite.py --tier C1.

excludedTargets.LetValue.const: Pure-phase construct: toImpure rewrites it into the LetValue.fap / pap forms before the lowerer runs, so no declaration is refused because of it. The matrix row records rejected because L1 (81986e6a) deleted the pure-phase lowering; a program selected for a `Foo.bar` reference would exercise no rejected path.
excludedTargets.LetValue.fap.gf_simd: GF(2^128)/BabyBear/Goldilocks SIMD intrinsic whitelist has no syntactic surface in upstream test files; the matrix row records 0 hits across Std/Init+C2, C1, and con-leche corpora.
excludedTargets.LetValue.proj: Pure-phase construct: toImpure rewrites it into the LetValue.oproj / uproj / sproj forms before the lowerer runs, so no declaration is refused because of it. The matrix row records rejected because L1 (81986e6a) deleted the pure-phase lowering; a program selected for `.fst` / `.snd` would exercise no rejected path.
